notes.title: Indygo goes polyglot!
notes.content:
Hey there,

We have another great announcement, especially for those of you, who are neither Polish, nor English and feel more comfortable playing a game which supports their language. 
We think that you already know what we are about to say...

...That’s right! 
[b]Indygo will be available in 7different languages for you to enjoy![/b]

You will be able to play the game in:
- English,
- German,
- French,
- Italian,
- Spanish,
- Russian.
- Polish.

Both the subtitles and the interface will be translated to the language of your choosing.
Moreover, [b]there will also be full audio support for Polish and English.[/b]

Stay tuned for more great news!

notes.title: On the podium of The Big Indie Pitch!
notes.content:
Hi All,

We want to share some great news with you!!!

During [url=http://www.gamearena.pl/en]PGA (Poznań Game Arena)[/url], the biggest game show in Poland held last week, we took part in The Big Indie Pitch at [url=http://www.gamearena.pl/en/news/the_biggest_gamedev_event_in_central_and_eastern_europe]Game Industry Conference.[/url] 

And guess what? 
...
...
...
[h1][b]We made it to 3rd place![/b][/h1] 

We put a lot of heart and effort in our project and we are really grateful that it shows.
Not only did we want to create a game that would be engaging, but we also wanted to shed light on the important issue of depression and it seems we did a pretty good job. 

We hope that you will find Indygo as interesting as the jury found it. 
As always, thank you for your support along our way!

Hugs!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30447681/2fb1518e57fc2bef4fcc4a0d1746d3806283c42d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Get ready for the launch date - 24.10.2017!
notes.content:
Hi All,

we are extremely happy and proud to announce that Indygo will debut on Steam on 24.10.2017 (Tuesday)!

We will have full English and Polish voice-overs!

Full TXT support (interface & subtitles) will be available for the following localizations:
- English			
- French			
- Italian			
- German			
- Spanish			
- Polish			
- Russian	

Stay tuned and [b]ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST! :)[/b]

Hi All!

as our Indygo game is going to come out soon, we would like to share a gift with you - [b]"Anna's Diary"[/b], an ebook introducing the story!

The ebook is a prequel to the game.
It tells the story of how Thomas, the protagonist, and his girlfriend Anna met. 
It also gives an insight of when and how Thomas’s state began to worsen.

[b]It is FREE![/b]

All available formats for your best convenience!:
- PDF
- EPUB
- MOBI
